def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate tau_filter is not boolean
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")

    # Helper validation function
    def validate_matrix(arr, name):
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a NumPy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (expected nonpositive)")

    validate_matrix(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result")
    validate_matrix(logp_call_only, "logp_call_only")
    validate_matrix(logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All matrices must have the same shape")

    # Validate tau_filter is finite and nonnegative
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Step T01: Normalize decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)  # t = j - i, first future token t=0
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Step T02: Compute weighted future-token loss (negative weighted log probability)
    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)

    # Step T03: Use the stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    # Step T04: Compute margin and apply threshold
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
